4921 subroutine read_alphavar
4922 implicit none
4923 ! put the initial parameter wavefunction in alphavar
4924
4925 if (np .gt. 0) then
4926
4927 if (iopt .eq. 1 .or. .not. yesquantum) then
4928

4930
4931 indc = 0

4933 do k = indc + 1, indc + iesinv
4934 alphavar(k) = ddwsz(k - indc)
4935 end do
4936 end if
4937 indc = indc + iesinv
4938 if (iesm .ne. 0) then
4939 do k = indc + 1, indc + iesm
4940 alphavar(k) = vju(k - indc)
4941 end do
4942 end if
4943 indc = indc + iesm
4944
4945 if (iesd .ne. 0) then
4946 do k = indc + 1, indc + iesd
4947 alphavar(k) = vj(k - indc)
4948 end do
4949 end if
4950 indc = indc + iesd
4951
4952 if (iesfree .ne. 0) then
4953 do k = indc + 1, indc + iesfree
4954 alphavar(k) = ddw(k - indc)
4955 end do
4956 end if
4957 indc = indc + iesfree
4958
4959 if (iessw .ne. 0) then
4960 do k = indc + 1, indc + iessw
4961 alphavar(k) = dsw(k - indc)
4962 end do
4963 end if
4964 indc = indc + iessw
4965
4966 if (iesup .ne. 0) then
4967 do k = indc + 1, indc + iesup
4968 alphavar(k) = dup(k - indc)
4969 end do
4970 end if
4971
4972 indc = indc + iesup
4973
4974 if (iesking .ne. 0) then
4975 do k = indc + 1, indc + iesking
4976 alphavar(k) = dekg(k - indc)
4977 end do
4978 end if
4979 indc = indc + iesking
4980
4981 if (ieskin .ne. 0) then
4982 ! The ion mapping coordinates
4983 do k = indc + 1, indc + ieskin
4984 alphavar(k) = dek(k - indc)
4985 end do
4986 end if
4987
4988 if (iespbc .and. itestr .eq. -5) then
4989 ! Restoring consistency with fort.10
4990 if (ieskint .eq. ieskinr_pos + 2) then
4991 dek(ieskinr_pos + 1 - iesking) = cellscale(2)
4992 dek(ieskinr_pos + 2 - iesking) = cellscale(3)
4993 elseif (ieskint .eq. ieskinr_pos + 1) then
4994 dek(ieskinr_pos + 1 - iesking) = cellscale(1)
4995 elseif (ieskint .eq. ieskinr_pos + 3) then
4996 dek(ieskinr_pos + 1 - iesking) = cellscale(1)
4997 dek(ieskinr_pos + 2 - iesking) = cellscale(2)
4998 dek(ieskinr_pos + 3 - iesking) = cellscale(3)
4999 end if
5000 end if
5001
5002 else
5003 ! Read parameters from alphavar
5004 indc = 0
5005 if (iesinv .ne. 0) then
5006 do k = indc + 1, indc + iesinv
5007 ddwsz(k - indc) = alphavar(k)
5008 end do
5009 end if
5010 indc = indc + iesinv
5011 if (iesm .ne. 0) then
5012 do k = indc + 1, indc + iesm
5013 vju(k - indc) = alphavar(k)
5014 end do
5015 end if
5016 indc = indc + iesm
5017
5018 if (iesd .ne. 0) then
5019 do k = indc + 1, indc + iesd
5020 vj(k - indc) = alphavar(k)
5021 end do
5022 end if
5023 indc = indc + iesd
5024
5025 if (iesfree .ne. 0) then
5026 do k = indc + 1, indc + iesfree
5027 ddw(k - indc) = alphavar(k)
5028 end do
5029 end if
5030 indc = indc + iesfree
5031
5032 if (iessw .ne. 0) then
5033 do k = indc + 1, indc + iessw
5034 dsw(k - indc) = alphavar(k)
5035 end do
5036 end if
5037 indc = indc + iessw
5038
5039 if (iesup .ne. 0) then
5040 do k = indc + 1, indc + iesup

5042 end do
5043 end if
5044
5045 indc = indc + iesup
5046
5047 if (iesking .ne. 0) then
5048 do k = indc + 1, indc + iesking
5049 dekg(k - indc) = 0.d0
5050 alphavar(k) = 0.d0
5051 end do
5052 end if
5053 indc = indc + iesking
5054
5055 if (iespbc .and. itestr .eq. -5) then
5056 ! Restoring consistency with fort.10
5057 if (ieskint .eq. ieskinr_pos + 2) then
5058 cellscale(2) = dek(ieskinr_pos + 1 - iesking)
5059 cellscale(3) = dek(ieskinr_pos + 2 - iesking)
5060 cellscale(1) = omega/cellscale(2)/cellscale(3)
5061 elseif (ieskint .eq. ieskinr_pos + 1) then
5062 cellscale(1) = dek(ieskinr_pos + 1 - iesking)
5063 cellscale(2:3) = 1.d0
5064 elseif (ieskint .eq. ieskinr_pos + 3) then
5065 cellscale(1) = dek(ieskinr_pos + 1 - iesking)
5066 cellscale(2) = dek(ieskinr_pos + 2 - iesking)
5067 cellscale(3) = dek(ieskinr_pos + 3 - iesking)
5068 end if
5069 end if
5070
5071 if (ieskin .ne. 0) then
5072 ! The ion mapping coordinates
5073 do k = indc + 1, indc + ieskin
5074 if (k - indc .le. ieskinr_pos - iesking) then
5075 dek(k - indc) = 0.d0
5076 alphavar(k) = 0.d0
5077 else
5078 dek(k - indc) = alphavar(k)
5079 end if
5080 end do
5081 end if
5082
5083 end if ! not yesquantum or iopt=1
5084
5085 end if ! np.gt.0
5086
5087 end subroutine read_alphavar
5088
5089end
